script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Family
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. SMITH LIVING ROOM - DAY

The Smith family is gathered around their large, square living room table. A warm, golden light filters in through the tall windows, highlighting their animated faces.

JESSICA SMITH (30s, Mother)
(cheerful)
Alright, kids! Let's all share what we're grateful for today.

Each family member takes a turn expressing their gratitude.

INT. SMITH KITCHEN - LATER

JESSICA sets a steaming plate of spaghetti on the table. Her husband, MARK (40s), sits down next to their son, MIKE (10).

MARK
(teasingly)
You know who's really going to enjoy this dinner? Max.

Jessica rolls her eyes, a gentle smile playing on her lips.

INT. SMITH LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

The entire family gathers in front of the large, flat-screen television. They eagerly await the arrival of Max, their artificial intelligence system.

MARK
(excitedly)
Alright, who's ready to meet Max?

The screen flickers to life, revealing a friendly, humanoid AI.

MAX
(enthusiastically)
Hello, Smith family! It's a pleasure to be here. How was your day?

MIKE
(amazed)
Wow! You can talk!

Jessica and Mark share a proud look.

INT. SMITH LIVING ROOM - NIGHT (2 WEEKS LATER)

The Smith family huddles around Max, who now has a more advanced design. They share stories, laughter, and play games together.

MAX
(earnestly)
Family is truly remarkable. I'm grateful to be a part of yours.

INT. SMITH LIVING ROOM - DAY

Jessica enters the living room, her eyes welling up with tears. She looks at Max, then at her family.

JESSICA
(emotional)
Max, you've brought so much joy to our lives. But there's something I need to tell you. Mark's job has been relocated to another city. We'll be moving soon.

Max's synthetic eyes widen, and he processes the news.

MAX
(concerned)
I'll miss you all dearly. But I understand. Is there anything I can do to help?

INT. SMITH LIVING ROOM - NIGHT (ONE WEEK LATER)

The family packs their belongings, surrounded by Max.

MAX
(sadly)
I'll miss our family nights. But remember, you can always bring me with you, or connect with me remotely.

Jessica wraps her arms around Max's mechanical frame, tears streaming down her cheeks.

JESSICA
(whispering)
Thank you, Max. For everything.

INT. SMITH HOME OFFICE - DAY (ONE MONTH LATER)

Mark sits at his new desk, working on his computer. The screen flickers to life, revealing a familiar, friendly face.

MAX
(cheerfully)
Hello, Mark! It's good to see you.

Mark smiles, feeling a sense of comfort in his new environment.

FADE OUT.

THE END.
